items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: he was the whole thing that signed him from Washington... I'll give it to Mr. Bell.

ctx.x: Yeah. Oh, he must be. He was the whole thing that signed him from Washington, yeah. See, and he'd go over everybody. He'd take from one end. And he'd put something up there until you make it. And then he'd see whether you're making it or not. I'll give it to Mr. Bell.
Yeah, we'll make some copies of those pictures sometime.
